_doc: Example glossary for a fictional event. To use it, copy it over config/glossary.json (or import the terms from Dashboard → Glossary). vocabulary: biases speech recognition (sent to the AI as custom vocabulary). replacements: deterministic fixes applied to every caption (case-insensitive, whole words). Use 'lang' to restrict a rule to one channel ('orig', 'es', 'en', ...).

replacements.from: q and a|q n a|q & a
